title: Private Historic Horse & Carriage Tour of Charleston
includes: Private Horse & Carriage Tour of Charleston (1-4 people)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Please note: Routes are chosen prior to departure on the date of travel. This is determined by a City of Charleston Tourism official and is out of the control of the local operator and we are unable to guarantee times.
Please select quantity ONE (1) at checkout to reserve one private carriage. Each carriage can accomodate 1-4 people. Price displayed is per carriage.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy Charleston's beauty and charm in one of our private vis-à-vis carriages that accommodates up to 4 guests. This private carriage ride will sure to be a highlight during your visit to the holy city. This tour begins and ends in the Historic City Market. Hotel pick-up drop-off not included.
